{{Quote|They picked me up poking around Joiol system and took me to the Chimaera.|[[Mazzic]] to [[Talon Karrde]]|<ref name="The Last Command">''[[The Last Command]]''</ref>}}
The '''Joiol system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] in the [[Orus sector/Legends|Orus sector]] of the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] Territories that contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Joiol]].

==History==
During the [[Thrawn campaign]], [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]] captured the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Mazzic]] in the Joiol system and tried to convince him that he wasn't responsible of the [[Ambush on Trogan]].
